entries: 在灰鷹的世界中，目前已知僅有九把這類寶劍存在於世。它們都是那被以「最終遺言」之名廣為傳誦的傳奇寶劍，弗拉格拉克，的仿製品。這九把劍各自有著其獨特的名稱和陣營，且在劍柄末端鑲有不同的寶石。
傷害者，守序邪惡之劍，在其劍柄末梢鑲有一顆石榴石。
你在使用這把劍進行的攻擊檢定和傷害骰上具有+3加值。此外，當你持握這把劍時，你可以使用你的反應以在任何位於你觸及範圍內的生物對你造成傷害時以這把劍對它進行一次近戰攻擊。你在該攻擊檢定中具有優勢，且任何這次特殊攻擊所造成的傷害都將無視目標擁有的任何傷害免疫或抗性。

item.name: Sword of Answering (Squelcher)
entries: 在灰鷹的世界中，目前已知僅有九把這類寶劍存在於世。它們都是那被以「最終遺言」之名廣為傳誦的傳奇寶劍，弗拉格拉克，的仿製品。這九把劍各自有著其獨特的名稱和陣營，且在劍柄末端鑲有不同的寶石。
毀滅者，中立邪惡之劍，在其劍柄末梢鑲有一顆尖晶石。
你在使用這把劍進行的攻擊檢定和傷害骰上具有+3加值。此外，當你持握這把劍時，你可以使用你的反應以在任何位於你觸及範圍內的生物對你造成傷害時以這把劍對它進行一次近戰攻擊。你在該攻擊檢定中具有優勢，且任何這次特殊攻擊所造成的傷害都將無視目標擁有的任何傷害免疫或抗性。

item.name: Sword of Kas
entries: 當維克那的力量逐漸壯大時，他任命了一名邪惡而冷酷的副手——血手卡斯——擔任他的護衛與左右手。這個卑劣的惡棍身兼顧問、軍閥與刺客。他的功績贏得了維克那的讚賞與一份獎賞：一把出身與其持有者同樣黑暗的劍。
很長一段時間，卡斯忠心侍奉這位{@creature lich||巫妖}，但隨著卡斯的力量增長，他的狂妄也與日俱增。他的劍慫恿他取代維克那，好讓他們代替維克那統治{@creature lich||巫妖}的帝國。傳說維克那死於卡斯之手，但維克那也為他叛變的副手帶來了毀滅，只留下卡斯的劍。世界也因此變得更光明了。
卡斯之劍是一把有知覺的魔法長劍，以它進行的攻擊與傷害擲骰獲得 +3 加值。擲出 19 或 20 時造成重擊，並對不死生物額外造成 {@damage 2d10} 點劈砍傷害。
若這把劍在從劍鞘中拔出後 1 分鐘內沒有沐浴在鮮血中，其持用者必須進行一次 {@dc 15} 魅力豁免檢定。成功時，持用者受到 {@damage 3d6} 點心靈傷害。失敗時，持用者如同受到{@spell dominate monster||支配怪物}法術般被劍支配，而劍會要求沐浴鮮血。當劍的要求被滿足時，法術效果結束。

entries.name: Random Properties
entries: 卡斯之劍擁有以下隨機屬性：

items: 1 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|次要有益屬性}
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|dmg|主要有益屬性}
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|dmg|次要有害屬性}
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Detrimental Properties|dmg|主要有害屬性}

entries.name: Spirit of Kas
entries: 當劍在你身上時，你在每場戰鬥開始時於先攻上加一顆 {@dice d10}。此外，當你使用一個動作用這把劍攻擊時，你可以將其部分或全部攻擊加值改為轉移到你的護甲等級上。調整後的加值持續到你下個回合開始。

entries.name: Spells
entries: 當劍在你身上時，你可以使用一個動作從它施展以下其中一道法術（豁免 18）：{@spell call lightning||召雷術}、{@spell divine word||聖言術}或{@spell finger of death||死亡一指}。一旦你用這把劍施展了一道法術，在下一個黎明之前無法再從它施展該法術。

entries.name: Sentience
entries: 卡斯之劍是一把有知覺的混亂邪惡武器，智力 15、感知 13、魅力 16。它具有聽覺以及範圍 120 呎的{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}。
這把武器以心靈感應與其持用者溝通，並能說、讀、理解通用語。

entries.name: Personality
entries: 這把劍的目的是讓維克那毀滅。殺死維克那的崇拜者、摧毀{@creature lich||巫妖}的造物，以及挫敗他的陰謀，都有助於實現這個目標。
卡斯之劍也試圖摧毀任何被維克那之眼與{@item Hand of Vecna||維克那之手}腐化的人。這把劍對那些神器的執念，最終會成為其持用者的執迷。

entries.name: Destroying the Sword
entries: 同時與{@item Eye of Vecna||維克那之眼}和{@item Hand of Vecna||維克那之手}同調的生物，可以使用這兩件神器合併後的祈願屬性來毀滅卡斯之劍。該生物必須施展{@spell wish||祈願術}法術，並進行一次魅力檢定，與劍的魅力檢定進行對抗。劍必須位於該生物 30 呎內，否則法術失敗。若劍在對抗中勝出，什麼事也不會發生，{@spell wish||祈願術}法術被浪費。若劍在對抗中落敗，它便會被摧毀。

item.name: Sword of Kas
entries: 卡斯是一名侍奉{@book 維克那|XDMG|8|Vecna}的強大戰士，他的忠誠換來了這把劍作為獎賞。隨著卡斯的力量增長，他的傲慢也隨之膨脹。這把劍慫恿卡斯消滅維克那並篡奪其王座。傳說維克那死於卡斯之手，但維克那也為他這名叛變的副官帶來了毀滅，只留下卡斯的劍。

entries.name: Bloodthirst
entries: 此劍渴求鮮血。若此劍從劍鞘中拔出後 1 分鐘內，劍刃未嚐到鮮血，其持用者進行一次 {@dc 15} 魅力豁免檢定。豁免成功時，持用者受到 {@damage 3d6} 心靈傷害。豁免失敗時，持用者會被此劍支配，如同受到{@spell Dominate Monster|XPHB|支配怪物}法術影響，而此劍要求鮮血。當此劍的要求被滿足時，法術效果結束。

entries.name: Magic Weapon
entries: 以此劍進行的攻擊檢定與傷害擲骰獲得 +3 加值，其 {@dice d20} 擲出 19 或 20 時造成{@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB|重擊}，並對不死生物額外造成 {@damage 2d10} 劈砍傷害。

entries.name: Random Properties
entries: 此劍具有以下隨機屬性：

items: 1 個{@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|XDMG|次要有益}屬性
1 個{@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|XDMG|主要有益}屬性
1 個{@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|XDMG|次要有害}屬性
1 個{@table Artifact Properties; Major Detrimental Properties|XDMG|主要有害}屬性

entries.name: Spells
entries: 此劍在你身上時，你可以從中施展下列法術（豁免 {@dc 18}）：
一旦你使用此劍施展某道法術，直到下一個黎明前都無法再從劍中施展該法術。

entries.name: Spirit of Kas
entries: 此劍在你身上時，你獲得以下益處：

items.name: Battle Hunger
entries: 你的{@variantrule Initiative|XPHB|先攻}擲骰加上 {@dice 1d10}。

items.name: Blade of Defense
entries: 當你執行一個動作以此劍攻擊時，你可以將其部分或全部攻擊加值轉移到你的{@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB|護甲等級}上。調整後的加值會持續到你的下個回合開始。

items.name: Necrotic Resistance
entries: 你對黯蝕傷害具有{@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|抗性}。

entries.name: Sentience
entries: 卡斯之劍是一把具有感知力的混亂邪惡武器，智力 15、感知 13、魅力 16。它具有聽覺以及 120 呎的{@sense Darkvision|XPHB|黑暗視覺}。
此武器以心靈感應與其持用者溝通，並能說通用語。

entries.name: Personality
entries: 此劍的目的是為維克那帶來毀滅。殺死維克那的信徒、摧毀這名巫妖的造物，以及挫敗他的陰謀，都有助於實現此目標。
卡斯之劍也會設法消滅任何被{@item Eye and Hand of Vecna|XDMG|維克那之眼與手}腐化的人。

entries.name: Destroying the Sword
entries: 同時與{@item Eye of Vecna|XDMG|維克那之眼}和{@item Hand of Vecna|XDMG|維克那之手}同調的生物，可以使用這兩件神器合併後的{@spell Wish|XPHB|祈願術}屬性來毀滅卡斯之劍，前提是劍位於該法術施法者 30 呎內。施展祈願術時，該生物進行一次 {@dc 18} 魅力豁免檢定。豁免失敗時，什麼也不會發生，{@spell Wish|XPHB|祈願術}法術也被浪費。豁免成功時，卡斯之劍被摧毀。

item.name: Sword of the Paruns
entries: 你以這把魔法武器進行的攻擊檢定與傷害擲骰獲得 +1 加值。此外，在你的每個回合一次，若你持握這把劍，你可以使用以下屬性之一：

items: 在你使用{@action Attack||攻擊}動作以劍攻擊後，你可以立即讓你 60 呎內的一個生物使用它的反應進行一次武器攻擊。
在你採取{@action Dash||疾走}動作後，你可以立即讓你 60 呎內的一個生物使用它的反應移動至多等於其速度的距離。
在你採取{@action Dodge||閃避}動作後，你可以立即讓你 60 呎內的一個生物使用它的反應獲得{@action Dodge||閃避}動作的益處。

item.name: Sword of Zariel
item.reqAttune: by 劍認為值得的生物
entries: This longsword belonged to the angel Zariel before her fall from grace. Fashioned from celestial steel, it gives off a faint glow and hum. The weapon chooses who can attune to it and who can't. It desires a wielder who embodies bravery and heroism.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: The sword allows you to attune to it immediately, without having to take a short rest. The first time you attune to the sword, you are transformed into a heavenly, idealized version of yourself, blessed with otherworldly beauty and a touch of heaven in your heart. Neither magic nor divine intervention can reverse this transformation. Your alignment becomes lawful good, and you gain the following traits:

items.name: Angelic Language
items.entry: You can speak, read, and write Celestial.

items.name: Celestial Resistance
items.entry: You have resistance to necrotic and radiant damage.

items.name: Divine Presence
items.entry: Your Charisma score becomes 20, unless it is already 20 or higher.

items.name: Feathered Wings
items.entry: You sprout a beautiful pair of feathered wings that grant you a flying speed of 90 feet and the ability to hover. If you already have a different kind of wings, these new wings replace the old ones, which fall off.

items.name: Truesight
items.entry: Your eyes become luminous pools of silver. You can see in normal and magical darkness, see {@condition invisible} creatures and objects, automatically detect visual illusions and succeed on saving throws against them, perceive the original form of a shapechanger or a creature that is transformed by magic, and see into the Ethereal Plane, all within a range of 60 feet.

items.name: New Personality
entries: You gain new personality traits, determined by rolling once on each of the following tables. These traits override any conflicting personality trait, ideal, bond, or flaw.

entries.caption: Personality Traits
rows: I treat all beings, even enemies, with respect.
I won't tell a lie.
I enjoy sharing my philosophical worldview and experiences with others.
I cut right to the chase in every conversation.
I often quote (or misquote) religious texts.
I anger quickly when I witness cruelty or injustice.
My praise and trust are earned and never given freely.
I like everything clean and organized.

entries.caption: Ideals
rows: Charity. I always help those in need. (Good)
Faith. I choose to follow the tenets of a particular lawful good deity to the letter. (Lawful)
Responsibility. It is the duty of the strong to protect the weak. (Lawful)
Respect. All people deserve to be treated with dignity. (Good)
Honor. The way I conduct myself determines my reward in the afterlife. (Lawful)
Redemption. All creatures are capable of change for the better. (Good)

entries.caption: Bonds
rows: I have a favorite religious hymn that I constantly hum.
I must keep a written record of my beliefs and the sins that I witness. When finished, this book will be my gift to the multiverse.
I have cherished memories of Idyllglen, though I've only seen this bucolic town in dreams.
I would die for those who fight beside me, regardless of their faults.
I seek to honor the angel Zariel by destroying fiends and other evildoers wherever I find them.
The Sword of Zariel has chosen me. I shall not fail to wield it justly.

entries.caption: Flaws
rows: I am too quick to judge others.
I offer forgiveness too readily.
I will sacrifice innocent lives for the greater good.
Flaw? What flaw? I am flawless. Utter perfection!
I allow nothing to stand in the way of my crusade to eradicate evil from the multiverse.
I ignore those who do not support my plans, for my calling is higher than all others.

entries.name: Holy Light
entries: The sword sheds bright light in a 5-foot radius and dim light for an additional 5 feet. Fiends find the sword's light disconcerting and painful, even if they can't see it, and have disadvantage on attack rolls made within the weapon's radius of bright light.
As a bonus action, you can intensify the sword's light, causing it to shed bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for an additional 15 feet, or reduce its glow to its normal intensity.

entries.name: Random Properties
entries: The sword has 2 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|minor beneficial properties}.

entries.name: Searing Radiance
entries: The sword deals an extra 9 ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage to any creature it hits, or 16 ({@damage 3d10}) radiant damage if you're wielding the weapon with two hands. An evil creature that takes this radiant damage must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Sentience
entries: The Sword of Zariel is a sentient, lawful good item with an Intelligence of 10, a Wisdom of 20, and a Charisma of 18. It has hearing and normal vision out to a range of 30 feet.
The sword communicates by transmitting emotion to the creature carrying or wielding it.

entries.name: Truth Seer
entries: While holding the sword, you gain advantage on all Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) checks.

entries.name: Destroying the Sword
entries: Zariel can destroy the sword simply by grasping it. She couldn't bring herself to do so when she was an angel, but as an archdevil she has no compunction about ridding the multiverse of the weapon. The sword is also destroyed if it's used to shatter the Companion (see "{@adventure Shattering the Companion|BGDIA|8|shattering the companion}"), unless the blade is wielded by an angel of challenge rating 15 or higher, or a good-aligned cleric or paladin of at least 10th level.
If Zariel is killed for good (that is, if she dies in the Nine Hells), the sword becomes no harder to destroy than a normal longsword.

item.name: Tablet of Reawakening
entries: Witches of Rashemen created this Tiny stone tablet to counter the necromancy of the Red Wizards. As an action, you can cast {@spell true resurrection} from the tablet. Once used in this way, the tablet turns to dust and is destroyed.

item.name: Talarith
entries: The {@creature reigar|BAM} who creates this piece of jewelry chooses its form: bracelet, brooch, diadem, or necklace. While the reigar wears the talarith, any weapon wielded by the {@creature reigar|BAM} deals an extra {@damage 1d6} force damage when it hits.

As an action, a reigar can use its talarith to summon a golem that looks just like the reigar. The golem obeys the reigar's commands and uses the {@creature reigar|BAM|reigar's} statistics, except it is a Construct that doesn't have a talarith of its own. The golem vanishes after 1 hour, or when it is reduced to 0 hit points. After summoning a golem, the reigar must finish a short or long rest before this property can be used again.

item.name: Talisman of Pure Good
entries: 這個護符是善良的強大象徵。一個既非善良也非邪惡陣營的生物會在觸碰這個護符時受到{@dice 6d6}光耀傷害。一個邪惡的生物則會在觸碰這個護符時受到{@dice 8d6}光耀傷害。這兩類生物在它們每次回合結束時若正持握或攜帶這個護符，則它們都將再次受到該傷害。
若你是一個善良的牧師或聖騎士，則你可以使用這個護符做為一個聖徽，且你在穿戴或持握它的期間在法術攻擊檢定中獲得+2加值。
這個護符含有7發充能。若你正穿戴或持握它，你可以使用一個動作以消耗1發充能，並選擇一個距離你120呎內，在地面上且你能看見的生物。若該生物屬於邪惡陣營，則一道烈焰裂隙將在它腳下開啟。目標必須成功通過一次DC 20的敏捷豁免，否則將摔入裂隙中並被摧毀，屍骨無存。這道裂隙接著將不留痕跡的關閉。當你消耗最後一發充能時，這個護符將粉碎成金黃色的光點並被摧毀。

item.name: Talisman of Pure Good
entries: 這個護符是良善的強大象徵。碰觸護符的邪魔或不死生物會受到 {@damage 8d6} 光耀傷害，且每次它在持有或攜帶護符的情況下結束回合時，都會再次受到此傷害。

entries.name: Holy Symbol
entries: 你可以將此護符作為聖徽使用。配戴或持有它時，你的法術攻擊檢定獲得 +2 加值。

entries.name: Pure Rebuke
entries: 此護符有 7 發充能。配戴或持有護符時，你可以執行一個{@action Magic|XPHB|魔法}動作消耗 1 發充能，以你 120 呎內一個你能看見的地面上的生物為目標。目標腳下裂開一道燃燒的裂縫，目標進行一次 {@dc 20} 敏捷豁免檢定。若目標是邪魔或不死生物，它在豁免上具有{@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB|劣勢}。豁免失敗時，目標墜入裂縫並被摧毀，不留任何殘骸。豁免成功時，目標沒有被拋入裂縫，但會因這番折磨受到 {@damage 4d6} 心靈傷害。無論哪種情況，裂縫隨後都會閉合，不留下任何存在過的痕跡。當你消耗最後一發充能時，護符會散成點點金光並被摧毀。

item.name: Talisman of the Sphere
entries: 當你在持握這個護符時進行用以控制{@item Sphere of Annihilation||湮滅法球}的智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定時，你使你的熟練加值在該檢定中變為兩倍。此外，當你在控制{@item Sphere of Annihilation||湮滅法球}期間開始你的回合，你可以使用一個動作使它飄移10呎加上等同於10x你的智力調整值呎數的距離。

item.name: Talisman of the Sphere
entries: 持有或配戴此護符時，你為控制{@item Sphere of Annihilation|XDMG|湮滅之球}而進行的任何智力（{@skill Arcana|XPHB|奧秘}）檢定都具有{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB|優勢}。此外，當你在控制{@item Sphere of Annihilation|XDMG|湮滅之球}的狀態下開始你的回合時，你可以執行一個{@action Magic|XPHB|魔法}動作將它移動 10 呎，外加等同於你智力調整值 10 倍的額外呎數。此移動不必是直線。

item.name: Talisman of Ultimate Evil
entries: 這個物品象徵著不思悔悟的邪惡。一個既非善良也非邪惡陣營的生物會在觸碰這個護符時受到{@dice 6d6}死靈傷害。一個善良的生物則會在觸碰這個護符時受到{@dice 8d6}死靈傷害。這兩類生物在它們每次回合結束時若正持握或攜帶這個護符，則它們都將再次受到該傷害。
若你是一個邪惡的牧師或聖騎士，則你可以使用這個護符做為一個聖徽，且你在穿戴或持握它的期間在法術攻擊檢定中獲得+2加值。
這個護符含有6發充能。若你正穿戴或持握它，你可以使用一個動作以消耗1發充能，並選擇一個距離你120呎內，在地面上且你能看見的生物。若該生物屬於善良陣營，則一道烈焰裂隙將在它腳下開啟。目標必須成功通過一次DC 20的敏捷豁免，否則將摔入裂隙中並被摧毀，屍骨無存。這道裂隙接著將不留痕跡的關閉。當你消耗最後一發充能時，這個護符將溶解成散發惡臭的黏液並被摧毀。

item.name: Talisman of Ultimate Evil
entries: 此物品象徵著毫不悔改的邪惡。碰觸護符的非邪魔、非不死生物會受到 {@damage 8d6} 黯蝕傷害，且每次它在持有或攜帶護符的情況下結束回合時，都會再次受到此傷害。

entries.name: Holy Symbol
entries: 你可以將此護符作為聖徽使用。配戴或持有它時，你的法術攻擊檢定獲得 +2 加值。

entries.name: Ultimate End
entries: 此護符有 6 發充能。配戴或持有護符時，你可以執行一個{@action Magic|XPHB|魔法}動作消耗 1 發充能，以你 120 呎內一個你能看見的地面上的生物為目標。目標腳下裂開一道燃燒的裂縫，目標進行一次 {@dc 20} 敏捷豁免檢定。若目標是天界生物，它在豁免上具有{@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB|劣勢}。豁免失敗時，目標墜入裂縫並被摧毀，不留任何殘骸。豁免成功時，目標沒有被拋入裂縫，但會因這番折磨受到 {@damage 4d6} 心靈傷害。無論哪種情況，裂縫隨後都會閉合，不留下任何存在過的痕跡。當你消耗最後一發充能時，護符會溶解成惡臭的黏液並被摧毀。

item.name: Talking Doll
entries: 當這個娃娃位於你 5 呎內時，你可以花費一次{@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|短休}教它說至多六句話，每句不超過六個字，並為每句話設定一個說出的條件。你也可以用新的句子取代舊的。無論條件為何，都必須發生在娃娃 5 呎內才會讓它開口。例如，每當有人拿起娃娃時，它可能會說：「我想要一顆糖果。」當你與娃娃的{@variantrule Attunement|XPHB|同調}結束時，娃娃的句子會消失。

item.name: Talking Doll
entries: 當這個填充玩偶距離你5呎內，你就可以花費一次短休的時間教導它說出最多六個短句，每個短句的長度都不能超過六個字，並為分別設定玩偶說出各短句的情境條件。你也可以將舊的短句替換成新的。無論設定的情境條件為何，它都必須發生在玩偶的5呎內才會使這個玩偶開口說話。舉例來說，每當某人將這個玩偶撿起，它可能會開口說出：「我想要一些糖果。」當你終止與玩偶的同調時，這個玩偶所學會的短句也將全部遺失。

item.name: Talons Card
entries: 作為一個動作，你可以揮舞這張牌，並指定你 120 呎內一件你能看見的魔法物品。若該物品不是神器，它的魔法屬性會被壓制 1 分鐘。此屬性使用後，在下一個黎明之前無法再次使用。

item.name: Tangler Grenade
entries: 纏絆手榴彈是一種煉金、非魔法的物品，有一個撞擊時會碎裂的卵形樹脂外殼。作為一個動作，生物可以將纏絆手榴彈擲向至多 60 呎外的一點。碎裂的纏絆手榴彈 10 呎內的每個生物都必須成功通過一次 {@dc 15} 敏捷豁免檢定，否則被黏稠的白色蛛網{@condition restrained||束縛}。作為一個動作，生物可以嘗試讓自己或其觸及範圍內的另一個生物脫離蛛網，成功通過一次 {@dc 20} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定即可。一加侖的酒精可以溶解單一纏絆手榴彈產生的蛛網。否則，蛛網會在 1 小時後自行溶解，釋放所有被它們{@condition restrained||束縛}的生物。

item.name: Tankard
entries: 一個啤酒杯可以容納1品脫的液體。

item.name: Tankard of Plenty
entries: This golden stein is decorated with dancing dwarves and grain patterns. Speaking the command word ("Illefarn") while grasping the handle fills the tankard with three pints of rich dwarven ale. This power can be used up to three times per day.

item.name: Tankard of Sobriety
entries: 這個大酒杯的一側雕有一張嚴肅的臉。你可以喝下倒入其中的麥酒、葡萄酒或任何其他非魔法酒精飲料，而不會喝醉。酒杯對魔法液體或毒藥等有害物質無效。

item.name: Tankard of Sobriety
entries: 這個啤酒杯的其中一面刻著一張嚴厲的臉孔。你可以喝下倒進它內部的麥酒、葡萄酒、或任何其它非魔法的酒精飲料而不會醉。這個啤酒杯對於魔法液體或有害物質（例如毒藥）不會發揮任何效果。

item.name: Taol
entries: 黃銅幣，約兩吋見方，中間有一個大到能放進{@item nib|wdh|尼布}的孔（1 陶爾幣 = 200 {@item nib|wdh|尼布}）

item.name: Tasha's Creeping Keelboat
entries: This magic vehicle is a boat 10 feet wide and 30 feet long. It has four legs that propel it across land and water. It has a walking and swimming speed of 20 feet, but it can't travel underwater. The boat moves according to your spoken directions while you are riding it, and creatures of your choice gain a +1 bonus to their Armor Class while on the boat.
The boat can transport up to 1,000 pounds without hindrance. It can carry up to twice this weight, but it moves at half speed if it carries more than its normal capacity.

item.name: Tearulai
entries: 長劍提魯萊是一把具有知覺、陣營為中立善良的{@item sword of sharpness||鋒銳之劍}，有著祖母綠色的劍刃，劍柄與柄頭嵌著珍貴寶石。在它從瓦德瑪的頭骨中被取出之前，劍的魔法屬性會被壓制。
邪惡生物無法與提魯萊同調；任何嘗試同調的邪惡生物會受到 20 點心靈傷害。這把武器的祖母綠劍刃無法被損壞或變鈍，且在劍與持用者彼此同調期間，劍無法在沒有持用者的情況下被傳送到任何地方。

entries.name: Spells
entries: 這把劍有 6 點充能，每天黎明恢復 {@dice 1d4 + 2} 點已消耗的充能。與劍同調的生物可以使用一個動作消耗 1 點或更多充能，從劍施展以下法術之一，不需要材料構材：{@spell fly||飛行術}（2 點充能）、{@spell polymorph||變形術}（3 點充能）或{@spell transport via plants||植物遁走術}（4 點充能）。

entries.name: Sentience
entries: 這把劍的智力為 17、感知 12、魅力 20。它具有聽覺，以及範圍 120 呎的{@sense truesight||真實視覺}。它以心靈感應與已同調的持用者溝通，能說、讀並理解通用語、龍語、精靈語與木族語。此外，這把劍能確定任何被帶到它 5 呎內之寶石的真正價值。

entries.name: Personality
entries: 提魯萊欣賞極致的美、音樂、精美藝術與詩歌。這把虛榮的武器總是努力改善自己的外表。它渴望寶石，並尋找更好的寶石來裝飾自己。最重要的是，它渴望回到它被打造的迷斯卓諾周圍的森林。若持用者的目標與它的目標相悖，提魯萊會試圖控制持用者並逃離地底山脈，之後它便能使用{@spell transport via plants||植物遁走術}法術回到它的來處。
當你以這把魔法劍攻擊一件物體並命中時，你對目標的武器傷害骰取最大值。
當你以這把武器攻擊一個生物且攻擊檢定擲出 20 時，該目標額外受到 14 點劈砍傷害。接著再擲一顆 {@dice d20}。若擲出 20，你斬斷目標的一條肢體，此損失的效果由 DM 決定。若該生物沒有可斬斷的肢體，你改為斬下它身體的一部分。
{@note 註：根據 SRD，額外傷害為 {@damage 4d6} 點劈砍傷害，不過{@link 這是錯誤的|https://rpg.stackexchange.com/a/174522/53884}。}
此外，你可以說出劍的命令語，讓劍刃在 10 呎半徑內發出明亮光線，並在額外 10 呎內發出微光。再次說出命令語或將劍收入鞘中會熄滅光芒。

item.name: Teeth of Dahlver-Nar
entries: 達爾佛納之牙是化為實體的故事。它們是一組牙齒，每顆都暗示著截然不同的來歷，由各種材料製成。這組牙齒放在一個皮革袋中，袋上繡著英雄與奇幻生物的圖案。牙齒落在哪裡，就會讓傳說在那裡化為現實。

entries.name: Using the Teeth
entries: 持握袋子時，你可以使用一個動作抽出一顆牙齒。在「達爾佛納之牙」表上擲骰決定你抽出哪顆牙齒，你可以選擇播種這顆牙齒或植入它（兩者皆於稍後說明）。
若你沒有播種或植入這顆牙齒，在你的回合結束時擲一顆骰子。若為偶數，牙齒會消失，生物如同你播種了這顆牙齒般出現，但它們對你與你的盟友懷有敵意。若為奇數，這顆牙齒會如同你植入它一般取代你的一顆牙齒（可能取代另一顆已植入的牙齒，見下文）。
每顆牙齒只能使用一次。記錄哪些牙齒已經使用過。若擲出已使用過之牙齒的結果，你改為抽出表上下一顆編號較低、尚未使用的牙齒。

entries.caption: 達爾佛納之牙
rows: 烏爾頓達的凝視之貓（象牙貓臼齒）
9 隻{@creature cat||貓}
這顆牙齒有 8 點充能。作為一個動作，你可以消耗 1 點充能，從牙齒施展{@spell revivify||回生術}法術。若你在你的回合開始時死亡，牙齒會消耗 1 點充能並對你施展{@spell revivify||回生術}。
達戈驚奇的一天（人類臼齒）
1 名{@creature commoner||平民}
當你完成一次長休時，牙齒會對你施展{@spell sanctuary||聖域術}（{@dc 18}），該法術持續 24 小時，或直到你打破它為止。
達坎的黃金時代（金色哥布林前臼齒）
10 隻{@creature goblin||哥布林}、1 隻{@creature goblin boss||哥布林頭目}
當你被攻擊命中且有盟友位於你 5 呎內時，你可以使用你的反應讓他們改為被命中。在你完成一次短休或長休之前，你無法再次使用此反應。
磨坊路謀殺案（半身人犬齒）
3 隻組成集會的{@creature green hag||綠鬼婆}
當你傷害一個在本場戰鬥中尚未進行過回合的目標時，該目標額外受到幽靈刀刃造成的 {@damage 3d10} 點劈砍傷害。
馬爾菲吉的厄運（翡翠蜥蜴人尖牙）
1 隻{@creature lizard queen||蜥蜴人女王}與 4 隻{@creature lizardfolk||蜥蜴人}
你長出爬蟲類的鱗片，使你的 AC 獲得 +2 加值。此外，當你完成一次長休時，你必須成功通過一次 {@dc 15} 體質豁免檢定，否則獲得 1 級{@condition exhaustion||力竭}。
馬夫的秘密（嚐起來甜甜的人類犬齒）
2 隻{@creature Incubus||夢魔}
當你對類人生物進行魅力檢定時，你可以擲一顆 {@dice d10}，並將擲出的數字作為加值加到結果上。該生物隨後會在下一個黎明對你懷有敵意。
驢子的夢（彩虹色驢子臼齒）
1 {@creature unicorn|MM|獨角獸}
這顆牙齒有 3 點充能。作為一個動作，你可以消耗 1 點充能觸碰一個生物。目標恢復 {@dice 2d8 + 2} 點生命值，且影響它的所有疾病與毒素都被移除。當你使用此動作時，一支閃爍的獨角獸角影像會從你的額頭長出，持續到你的回合結束。牙齒每天黎明恢復所有已消耗的充能。你獲得以下缺點：「當我看見邪惡正在發生，我必須反抗它。」
布拉爾之岩之外（銀色奪心魔牙齒）
2 隻{@creature mind flayer||奪心魔}
你獲得如《怪物圖鑑》所述、範圍 120 呎的心靈感應，且你可以隨意施展{@spell detect thoughts||偵測思想}法術，不需要構材。由於記憶與附近心智不斷的低語，你在感知（{@skill Insight||察言觀色}）與感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定上也具有劣勢。
半谷失蹤案（大型蟾蜍的犁骨齒）
4 隻{@creature giant toad||巨蟾蜍}
無論是否有助跑，你的跳遠距離至多 30 呎，跳高距離至多 15 呎。
幻影與鬼魂傳說（黑曜石人類臼齒）
1 隻{@creature giant octopus||巨章魚}、1 名{@creature mage||魔法師}、1 隻{@creature specter||幽靈}
作為一個動作，你可以使用這顆牙齒施展{@spell Evard's black tentacles||艾伐黑觸手}法術（{@dc 18}）。此屬性使用後，在下一個黎明之前無法再次使用。
詹德·日星的千次死亡（泛黃的吸血鬼尖牙）
1 隻{@creature vampire||吸血鬼}
你可以用啃咬攻擊作為徒手打擊。命中時，它造成 {@damage 1d6} 點穿刺傷害加上 {@damage 3d6} 點黯蝕傷害。你恢復等於所造成黯蝕傷害的生命值。當你處於陽光下時，你無法恢復生命值。
卡加什的噩夢（扭曲的眼魔牙齒）
1 隻{@creature beholder||眼魔}
作為一個動作，你可以從牙齒施展{@spell eyebite||攝心目光}法術。使用此動作後，在下一個黎明之前無法再次使用。每當你完成一次長休時，擲一顆 {@dice d20}。若擲出 20，一隻由 DM 選擇的異怪會出現在你 30 呎內並發動攻擊。
通往天空的三座橋（青金石鬼巫尖牙）
3 隻{@creature oni||惡鬼}
你獲得 30 呎的飛行速度，且你可以使用這顆牙齒隨意施展{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術。當你同調的魔法物品少於 3 件時，你獲得 1 級{@condition exhaustion||力竭}，在你與三件或更多魔法物品同調之前無法移除。
德拉哥薩之爪（斷裂的半透明尖牙）
1 隻{@creature adult red dracolich|tce}

你可以使用這顆牙齒施展{@spell create undead||創造不死生物}法術。此屬性使用後，在下一個黎明之前無法再次使用。每當你使用這顆牙齒創造一個不死生物時，一隻{@creature skeleton||骷髏}、{@creature zombie||殭屍}或{@creature ghoul||食屍鬼}也會出現在你 5 哩內的一個隨機地點，尋找可以殺戮的生者。被這些不死生物殺死的類人生物，會在下一個午夜化為同類型的不死生物復起。
萬古灰燼與永恆之火（翡翠類人生物前臼齒）
1 隻{@creature dao||土巨靈(達奧)}、1 隻{@creature djinni||氣巨靈(鎮尼)}、1 隻{@creature efreeti||火巨靈(伊夫利特)}、1 隻{@creature marid||水巨靈(瑪利德)}
你可以使用這顆牙齒以 9 環施展{@spell counterspell||反制法術}。使用此屬性後，在下一個黎明之前無法再次使用。每當你完成一次長休時，若你自上次長休以來未曾使用這顆牙齒反制過法術，你的生命值上限減少 {@dice 2d10}。若這使你的生命值上限降至 0，你便會死亡。
貝爾之女（綠鋼深淵魔鬼尖牙）
1 隻{@creature pit fiend||深獄煉魔}
你可以使用這顆牙齒施展{@spell dominate monster||支配怪物}（{@dc 18}）。使用此屬性後，在下一個黎明之前無法再次使用。你身上散發著濃烈的燃燒硫磺味。
天空為何尖嘯（藍龍尖牙）
1 隻{@creature ancient blue dragon||遠古藍龍}
你獲得對閃電傷害的免疫，以及對雷鳴傷害的易傷。
最後的泰拉斯克（泰拉斯克牙齒的鋸齒碎片）
1 隻{@creature tarrasque||泰拉斯奎巨獸}（無視你與你的命令，出現 {@dice 1d4} 輪後消失）
你對物體與建築物造成雙倍傷害。若你在一個回合中受到 20 點或更多傷害，你必須成功通過一次 {@dc 18} 感知豁免檢定，否則在你的下個回合陷入殺戮狂怒。在此狂怒期間，你必須使用你的動作，對傷害你的生物進行一次徒手打擊；若你並非受到生物傷害，則對一個你能看見的隨機生物進行，必要時盡可能移動接近目標。
因森達克斯之牙（帶紅寶石紋路的紅龍尖牙）
1 隻{@creature ancient red dragon||遠古紅龍}
你獲得對火焰傷害的免疫，且作為一個動作，你可以在 90 呎錐形內噴出火焰。該區域內的每個生物必須進行一次 {@dc 24} 敏捷豁免檢定，失敗時受到 {@damage 26d6} 點火焰傷害，成功時傷害減半。使用吐息武器後，你獲得 2 級{@condition exhaustion||力竭}。
達爾佛納之牙（滿是灰塵的人類臼齒）
1 名{@creature priest||祭司}
作為一個動作，你可以呼喚神聖力量前來援助你。描述你尋求的協助，由 DM 決定干預的性質（任何牧師法術的效果都是合適的）。此屬性使用後，在 7 天內無法再次使用。

entries.name: Sowing Teeth
entries: 要播種牙齒，你將它放在你觸及範圍內一處未佔據空間的地面上，或將它扔進你 10 呎內、至少寬 50 呎長 50 呎之水體中的一處未佔據空間。這麼做時，牙齒會鑽入地下消失，不留下任何洞口，或消失在水中。「召喚的生物」欄中所列的生物，會出現在盡可能接近牙齒播種處的未佔據空間。除非另有註明，這些生物是你的盟友，會說你所說的所有語言，並停留 10 分鐘後消失。

entries.name: Implanting Teeth
entries: 要植入牙齒，你將它放進嘴裡，接著你自己的一顆牙齒會脫落，而抽出的牙齒會取代它的位置，並調整大小以符合你的嘴巴。牙齒一旦植入，你便獲得「植入效果」欄中所列的效果。當你與這些牙齒同調時，牙齒無法被移除，且你無法自願結束與它們的同調。若在你死後被移除，牙齒便會消失。你一次最多可植入的牙齒數量等於 1 + 你的體質調整值（最少總共 2 顆）。若你嘗試植入更多牙齒，新植入的牙齒會隨機取代先前的其中一顆。被取代的牙齒會消失，你也會失去其植入效果。

entries.name: Recovering Teeth
entries: 一旦所有牙齒都消失，它們的袋子也會消失。裝有所有牙齒的袋子接著會出現在一個隨機的目的地，可能在物質位面的另一個世界上。

entries.name: Destroying the Teeth
entries: 每顆牙齒都必須被個別摧毀，方法是懷著摧毀它的意圖，將它播種在其故事起源的地區。以此方式種下時，召喚出的生物對你並不友善，也不會消失。有些被召喚的生物只會出發去尋找自己的家，其他的則會照著它們的故事行事。無論哪種情況，這顆牙齒都會永遠消失。

item.name: Tej
entries: 蜂蜜酒是一種以蜂蜜發酵而成的琥珀色飲料。在丘爾特，它比啤酒或麥酒更常見也更受歡迎。一杯蜂蜜酒在尼揚扎魯港售價 4 cp，在貝魯阿里安堡則是 6 cp。一桶 1 加侖的酒在城裡售價 2 sp，在堡壘則是 3 sp。

item.name: Teleportation Tablet
entries: This clay tablet is eight inches long, four inches wide, and half an inch thick. Inscribed on it is the sigil sequence for a permanent teleportation circle. A creature that studies the sequence for 10 minutes can make a {@dc 21} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check, learning the circle's destination on a success.

You can use an action to break the tablet in half, turning it to dust. If the tablet is broken while it is on the same plane of existence as the teleportation circle whose sigil sequence was engraved on it, a 10-foot-diameter teleportation circle of glowing blue light appears on the ground in an unoccupied space you choose within 30 feet of you. This teleportation circle has the characteristics of one created using the {@spell teleportation circle} spell, except that it connects to the teleportation circle whose sigil sequence appears on the tablet.
The teleportation circle created by the tablet disappears at the end of your next turn.

item.name: Teleporter Ring
entries: 作為一個動作，戴著傳送戒指的生物可以啟動 K22 區域或 E1 區域的傳送法陣，將自己與至多六名自願生物從一個法陣傳送到另一個法陣。

item.name: Telescopic Transporter
entries: 這具巨大的望遠鏡讓你能觀看遙遠的天體，包括恆星、狂野太空星系，以及星界之海的現象，例如神祇的城市或死去神祇石化的軀殼。
花費 1 小時校準望遠鏡後，你可以嘗試前往望遠鏡當前指向的行星或天體。在這 1 小時結束時，進行一次 {@dc 17} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定。檢定成功時，你與另外八名觸碰望遠鏡的自願生物，連同所有旅行者穿戴與攜帶的一切，安全地傳送到預定目的地的未被佔據空間。檢定失敗時，則會發生意外。DM 在「望遠鏡旅行意外」表上擲骰決定意外，或選擇一個適合戰役的意外。

entries.caption: 望遠鏡旅行意外
rows: 旅行者出現在星界之海中漂流。
旅行者出現在另一個存在位面，隨機決定或由 DM 選擇。
過多的宇宙能量使望遠鏡過載而爆炸。望遠鏡 60 呎內的每個生物受到 {@damage 8d6} 點黯蝕傷害。在此傷害中存活的任何類人生物會變成另一種生物，如同受到{@spell Reincarnate||轉生術}法術的影響。
一個來自星界之海的生物（例如一名{@creature githyanki knight||吉斯洋基騎士}）出現在望遠鏡 60 呎內。牠的態度由 DM 決定。
旅行者出現在最接近其目的地之狂野太空星系中的另一顆行星或天體上。
旅行者抵達預定目的地，但他們每個人身上都覆蓋著無害的黏液。

item.name: Tent
entries: 帳篷可供至多兩個小型或中型生物睡眠。

item.name: Tentacle Rod
entries: 由{@creature Drow||卓爾}製作，這把權杖是一把在末端有著三條軟韌觸手的魔法武器。當持握這把權杖時，你可以使用一個動作以引導這些觸手各自攻擊一個距離你15呎內且你所能看見的生物。每條觸手各自進行一次帶有+9命中加值的近戰攻擊檢定。若命中，該觸手將造成{@dice 1d6}鈍擊傷害。若你使用這三條觸手命中同一個目標，則它必須進行一次DC 15的體質豁免。若豁免失敗，該生物在接下來1分鐘內的速度將被減半，在敏捷豁免中具有劣勢，且無法使用它的反應。除此之外，在它的每個回合，它將只能使用一個動作或一個附贈動作，而不能在同一回合使用兩者。在它的每個回合結束時，它可以重複進行這個豁免檢定，豁免成功則結束這個效果對它的影響。

item.name: Tentacle Rod
entries: 此權杖的末端是三條橡膠般的觸手。持有權杖時，你可以執行一個{@action Magic|XPHB|魔法}動作指揮觸手向外伸展，每條觸手攻擊你 15 呎內一個你能看見的生物。為每條觸手進行一次近戰攻擊檢定，加值為 +9。觸手命中時造成 {@damage 1d6} 心靈傷害。若你以三條觸手都命中同一個目標，該目標必須通過一次 {@dc 15} 敏捷豁免檢定，否則處於{@condition Restrained|XPHB|束縛}狀態，直到你處於{@condition Incapacitated|XPHB|無力}狀態、你執行一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}釋放目標，或目標不再位於你 15 呎內為止。以此方式被{@condition Restrained|XPHB|束縛}期間，目標在其每個回合開始時受到 {@damage 3d6} 心靈傷害。在其每個回合結束時，目標重複此豁免，成功時結束自身的效果。

item.name: Thayan Spell Tattoo
entries: 這個魔法刺青蘊含一道由刺青製作者選擇的 1–3 環法術的精華。當刺青在你身上時，你總是準備著相關的法術，並可以使用你擁有的任何適當環階的法術位施展該法術。若你擁有施法或契約魔法特性，該法術使用你的施法屬性；否則，若法術需要豁免檢定或攻擊檢定，法術豁免 DC 為 13，攻擊加值為 +5。若你與刺青的{@variantrule Attunement|XPHB|同調}結束，刺青便會消失。
你也可以不使用法術位與法術構材施展該法術一次。以此方式施展法術後，刺青便會消失。

entries.name: Inking Thayan Spell Tattoos
entries: 賽的魔法刺青藝術被其施行者嚴加守護，因此賽法術刺青無法像其他魔法物品一樣被製作。要學習如何刺上賽法術刺青，你必須在紅袍法師中擁有 50 以上的聲望值。

要刺上賽法術刺青，你必須熟練{@skill Arcana|XPHB|奧秘}技能與{@item Calligrapher's Supplies|XPHB|書法家設備}，並在刺青的每一天都準備著該法術。你也必須備妥該法術所需的任何材料構材；若法術會消耗其材料構材，則在你完成刺青時消耗。刺上一個賽法術刺青所需的{@book 時間與金錢|XDMG|6|Time and Cost}，與抄寫同等環階的{@item Spell Scroll|XDMG|法術卷軸}相同。

items.name: Awakened
entries: 當這把釘頭錘進入覺醒狀態時，它獲得以下屬性：

items: 武器的攻擊檢定與傷害擲骰加值提升至 +2。
從釘頭錘施展之法術的豁免 DC 提升至 15。
當你以血腥終結的攻擊將一個生物的生命值降至 0 時，你可以造成以下效果：你 15 呎內每個你選擇的生物都必須成功通過一次 {@dc 15} 感知豁免檢定，否則在你下個回合結束前對你{@condition frightened||恐懼}。此屬性在下一個黎明之前無法再次使用。
當一個生物以近戰攻擊命中你時，你可以使用你的反應對攻擊者造成 {@damage 1d6} 點心靈傷害。

item.name: The Bloody End (Dormant)
entries: 這把精金釘頭錘承載著班恩的力量，有著一呎長的尖刺，柄頭上還有一片鋸齒狀的刀刃。

entries.name: Sentience
entries: 血腥終結是一把具有知覺的守序邪惡武器，智力 22、感知 18、魅力 24。它具有聽覺，以及範圍 120 呎的{@sense darkvision||黑暗視覺}。
這把武器以心靈感應與持用者溝通，能說、讀並理解通用語與煉獄語。

entries.name: Personality
entries: 一隻名叫伊澤爾齊的專橫{@creature pit fiend||深獄煉魔}住在血腥終結中。這把武器喧鬧地促使持用者征服他人，面對挑戰永不退縮。若持用者不要求他人效忠，這把武器很樂意代替持用者提出要求。

entries.name: Dormant
entries: 這把釘頭錘在休眠狀態下賦予以下益處：

items: 你以這把魔法武器進行的攻擊檢定與傷害擲骰獲得 +1 加值。
持握釘頭錘時，你可以使用一個動作從它施展以下法術之一（豁免 {@dc 13}）：{@spell charm person||魅惑人類}、{@spell dominate person||支配人類}或{@spell fear||恐懼術}。以釘頭錘施展過某道法術後，在下一個黎明之前無法再從它施展該法術。
持握釘頭錘時，你在魅力（{@skill Intimidation||威嚇}）檢定上具有優勢。

entries.name: Betrayer Artifact Properties
entries: 背叛者之武的力量成長方式與分歧遺物相同。在休眠狀態下，這些神器各有一項{@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|次要有益}屬性與一項{@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|dmg|次要有害}屬性。當神器進入覺醒狀態時，它會額外獲得一項{@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|次要有益}屬性與一項{@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|dmg|次要有害}屬性。當物品達到昇華狀態時，它會獲得一項{@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|dmg|主要有益}屬性。更多資訊請見《地下城主指南》第 7 章的「神器屬性」。

items.name: Exalted
entries: 當這把釘頭錘進入昇華狀態時，它獲得以下屬性：

items: 武器的攻擊檢定與傷害擲骰加值提升至 +3。
將{@spell dominate monster||支配怪物}加入可從釘頭錘施展的法術清單。
從釘頭錘施展之法術的豁免 DC，以及生物避免被它{@condition frightened||恐懼}的豁免 DC，提升至 17。
當你使用反應對以近戰攻擊命中你的生物造成心靈傷害時，心靈傷害提升至 {@damage 2d6}。

item.name: The Codicil of White
entries: 《白之附錄》是一本高而薄的書，以白色貂皮包覆在風乾的白松木板上，並以一個失去光澤的銀製扣環與鎖封住。書摸起來冰冷，毛皮的邊緣因使用而磨損。其中的二十七頁是外緣塗有銀箔的犢皮紙。整本書以肌腱條縫在皮革裝訂上，使它相當耐用。
持有這本附錄的生物具有寒冷傷害抗性。
這本附錄是歐呂爾的信徒所寫，作為崇拜她的入門書。第一頁是印有歐呂爾雪花標誌的扉頁。其餘頁面以令人不寒而慄的細節描述各種祭司儀式與典禮。在這些描述之中，藏著一道法師可以學習的法術（{@spell frost fingers|IDRotF|霜指術}），以及一首名為〈霜少女之韻〉的詩（見附錄 E）。這首詩是一段咒語，其力量可以用來劈開冰河（見第 6 章）。這首詩可能還有其他能力，由你決定

item.name: The Incantations of Iriolarthas
entries: 《伊瑞歐拉薩斯的咒語集》是一本沉重的法術書。它的黑色皮革封面上黏著死掉、長滿牙齒的蠕蟲，外面包覆著一層光亮的清漆。在前封面這片令人毛骨悚然的裝飾中，嵌著一個金色符文，形似一隻風格化的眼睛，瞳孔呈燭焰形狀——這是耐瑟瑞爾巫妖伊瑞歐拉薩斯的符印。
這本書有六十頁易碎的黃色犢皮紙。這些頁面上寫著以下法師法術：

items: 1 環：{@spell alarm||警報術}、{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}、{@spell identify||鑑定術}、{@spell magic missile||魔法飛彈}、{@spell shield||護盾術}、{@spell Tasha's hideous laughter||塔莎狂笑術}、{@spell thunderwave||雷鳴波}
2 環：{@spell arcane lock||祕法鎖}、{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}、{@spell invisibility||隱形術}、{@spell knock||敲擊術}、{@spell levitate||浮空術}、{@spell Melf's acid arrow||馬友夫強酸箭}、{@spell mirror image||鏡影術}
3 環：{@spell animate dead||活化死屍}、{@spell bestow curse||降咒}、{@spell clairvoyance||銳眼術}、{@spell counterspell||反制法術}、{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}、{@spell fireball||火球術}、{@spell glyph of warding||守衛銘文}
4 環：{@spell arcane eye||祕法眼}、{@spell banishment||放逐術}、{@spell blight||枯萎術}、{@spell dimension door||次元門}、{@spell Evard's black tentacles||艾伐黑觸手}、{@spell phantasmal killer||魅影殺手}
5 環：{@spell Bigby's hand||畢格比之掌}、{@spell cloudkill||死雲術}、{@spell dominate person||支配人類}、{@spell planar binding||異界誓縛}、{@spell scrying||探知}、{@spell telekinesis||心靈遙控}
6 環：{@spell create undead||創造不死生物}、{@spell disintegrate||解離術}、{@spell globe of invulnerability||法術無效結界}、{@spell move earth||地動術}、{@spell Otto's irresistible dance||奧圖狂舞術}
7 環：{@spell create magen|IDRotF|製造魔像人}、{@spell finger of death||死亡一指}、{@spell prismatic spray||虹光噴射}、{@spell teleport||傳送術}
8 環：{@spell demiplane||創造半位面}、{@spell dominate monster||支配怪物}、{@spell mind blank||心靈屏障}、{@spell power word stun||律令震懾}
9 環：{@spell blade of disaster|TCE|災厄之刃}、{@spell power word kill||律令死亡}

item.name_zh: 伊瑞歐拉薩斯的咒語集

item.name: The Infernal Machine of Lum the Mad
entries: This strange device was once thought to have been built by gods long forgotten and to have survived the eons since their passing, for it is incredibly ancient and crafted by means unlike anything known today. However, its true origins derive from a planar craft that crashed in the Barrier Peaks, for the Infernal Machine once functioned as this craft's central command console.

Explorers who discovered the crash site removed the command console and brought it back to civilization, not understanding its true purpose or powers. In later years, the console came into the possession of Baron Lum. By experimenting with its many controls, he was able to achieve astounding and destructive magical effects in the building of his empire, and so the artifact came to be known as the Infernal Machine of Lum the Mad. Yet with Lum's eventual defeat, his great machine was destroyed.

The Infernal Machine is a delicate, intricate, bulky, and heavy device, weighing some 5,500 pounds. It can be operated using a control panel containing sixty levers, forty dials, twenty switches, and a number of jeweled components. These controls generate all kinds of powers and effects, as noted below.

entries.name: Silver Wire
entries: The Infernal Machine's great size makes it largely immobile. To make ongoing use of the machine (such as while adventuring), it can be connected to its attuned user by a silver wire, a supply of which can always be produced from the machine's inner workings. This silver wire shares the same general nature as the silvery cord of an {@spell astral projection} spell, connecting to the body of the user and trailing behind them. When so attached, the wire becomes {@condition invisible}, astral, and extends to virtually infinite length.

As long as the wire remains intact, the attuned user can make full use of the Infernal Machine's powers, with their effects centered around the user. If the wire is cut—something that can happen only when an effect specifically states that it can cut an {@spell astral projection}'s silvery cord—the user suffers a sudden burst of feedback from the machine that kills them instantly.

Any effect of the Infernal Machine that requires {@status concentration} can be concentrated on by a remote user. The Infernal Machine's effects have a spell save DC of 14 or the attuned user's spell save DC, whichever is higher.

entries.name: Summon Monster
entries: When first used by Baron Lum, the Infernal Machine was known for its ability to unleash terrible monsters within the world. Specific combinations of its controls can still recreate the effects of various spells of the conjuration school, as follows:

items: 1/7 days: {@spell conjure minor elementals}, {@spell conjure woodland beings}, {@spell summon greater demon|XGE}

entries.name: Wish
entries: The Infernal Machine has the ability to bend the nature of reality, with the proper combination of controls recreating the effect of a {@spell wish} spell (including all side effects). Due to the complex nature of its programming, this feature can be used only once per month. Each time this effect is used, there is a cumulative {@chance 10} chance of the Infernal Machine malfunctioning, necessitating seven days' worth of repairs and reprogramming, as well as the expenditure of 500 gp in parts, before it can be used again. When these repairs are done, the cumulative chance of malfunction returns to 10 percent.

entries.name: Random Properties
entries: There are far more possible combinations for the Infernal Machine's controls than can ever be known or matrixed—especially as the controls shift position and reset themselves over time. At the end of each long rest of the user attuned to it, the Infernal Machine generates {@dice 1d4 + 1} random beneficial properties and {@dice 1d4 + 1} detrimental properties. Roll for each of these properties on the Infernal Machine Properties table. To keep things interesting, the DM might roll secretly for detrimental properties, revealing those properties only during the course of play.
Once set, these properties last until the end of the attuned user's next long rest.
(Our thanks to the D&D community for their suggestions for the properties of the Infernal Machine of Lum the Mad!)

entries.name: Destroying the Machine
entries: The Infernal Machine of Lum the Mad is self-repairing of anything short of catastrophic damage, and how it was disabled in Lum's time remains a mystery. It is rumored that if one specific combination of controls is set, the Infernal Machine will enter a repair mode, allowing unfettered access to its inner workings—and preventing it from restoring itself if it is attacked. Alternatively, other combinations of controls might cause the Infernal Machine to teleport its most critical components to some hiding place deep in space and time, rendering it inoperable until those components are found again.

entries.caption: Infernal Machine Properties
rows: You have a flying speed of 150 feet but lose all other movement.
You are {@condition blinded}.
You can cast the {@spell speak with animals} spell at will, but can use it to speak with only one animal of your choice.
All animals despise you. You have disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling}) checks.
One weapon or item you carry of your choice gains a walking speed of 30 feet and goes where you tell it.
Your armor and clothing feels unnaturally tight. Unless you go naked, roll a {@dice d4} each time you are attacked and subtract the number rolled from your AC.
You can cast the {@spell legend lore} spell three times.
Whenever you make an Intelligence check or use divination magic to learn something about a creature, that knowledge comes with added trivia of the DM's devising.
You emanate a weak magnetic aura. The first time during a combat that a creature attacks you with a metal weapon, that creature has disadvantage on the attack roll.
Metal rusts in response to your touch—including metal armor you wear and metal weapons you hold—reproducing the effect of the rust monster's Rust Metal trait.
Your fingers sprout tiny clockwork picks, granting you advantage on ability checks made using {@item thieves' tools|PHB} or {@item tinker's tools|PHB}.
Any metal object you wield or wear is covered in a thin layer of oil that drips occasionally and leaves your fingerprints everywhere.
You can cast the {@spell speak with animals} spell at will, but can use it to communicate only with insects.
Disturbing whispers on the edge of hearing haunt all creatures within 30 feet of you, causing those creatures to recall their saddest memories.
You have a +1 bonus to Wisdom ({@skill Insight} checks) involving creatures you can see.
Your body is ghostly and translucent except for your bones. You have vulnerability to radiant damage, and you have disadvantage on attack rolls while in direct sunlight.
You summon a {@creature unicorn} that obeys your commands. If you give a command that violates the unicorn's alignment, the unicorn immediately vanishes.
You grow a unicorn horn.

A specialized clockwork compass floats in front of you. You can name one character, place, or object on the same plane as you and have the compass point constantly in the direction of the named target. You gain no knowledge of the distance to the target.

A specialized clockwork compass floats in front of you, and points toward you. The DM determines whether a creature currently looking for you is drawn to your location. Additionally, when a creature attacks you for the first time during an encounter, it has advantage on the attack roll.
Your clothes are wrapped in illusion that makes them appear to be the very latest style, drawing praise and attention. You have a +1 bonus to Charisma checks.
Any food and drink you eat spoils as you swallow it. Each time you eat or drink, you are {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour.
You have a +1 bonus to attack rolls with weapons or spells (your choice).
The {@spell cure wounds} spell restores no hit points for you.
You have an innate sense of direction. You automatically succeed on ability checks made to avoid becoming lost.
Whenever you move, a magical voice calls out your direction and how far you've gone. The voice cannot be silenced or stopped.
You constantly see afterimages of all events that occurred within 30 feet of you over the previous hour.
You are distracted by voices and visions, forcing you to succeed on a Wisdom saving throw every 4 hours or gain one level of {@condition exhaustion}.
You understand all languages, as if under the effect of a {@spell comprehend languages} spell.
Whenever you speak, you speak in a random language (possibly including languages you don't normally know).
You have +1 bonus to initiative rolls.
You are unable to hear any speech louder than a whisper.
An exact duplicate of you appears next to you, dressed as you but lacking any gear. The duplicate functions as a familiar and has the statistics of a {@creature cat}.

An exact duplicate of you appears next to you, dressed as you but lacking any gear. It loudly tries to convince all other creatures that it is you, and you are its familiar. If destroyed, it reappears in {@dice 1d4} hours.

While you are afflicted by a disease or suffering the {@condition poisoned} or {@condition frightened} condition, whenever you hit a humanoid with a melee attack, the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, you transfer the disease or the condition to the target, and the disease or condition ends for you.

Water becomes intensely acidic to you. If you are submerged in water, you take {@damage 1d6} acid damage at the start of each of your turns, and drinking pure water causes you to be {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour.

A random Huge beast appears next to you (chosen by the DM) as if with the {@spell conjure animals} spell. You have a telepathic link to this beast, such that you can give it commands even if it can't hear you.
A random Huge beast appears next to you (chosen by the DM) and attacks at once.
You have 1 luck point, which you can use as if you had taken the Lucky feat. If you have taken that feat, you have 1 extra luck point.
Those around you perceive you as dishonest, even when you are completely truthful. You automatically fail Charisma checks.

If you drop to 0 hit points, a phantom guardian appears next to you, functioning as if you had cast the {@spell Mordenkainen's faithful hound} spell. The guardian disappears if you die, regain hit points, or regain consciousness.
No one takes you seriously, imposing disadvantage on Charisma ({@skill Deception} and {@skill Persuasion}) checks, and causing you to automatically fail Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) checks.
You can cast the {@spell gaseous form} spell on yourself three times. When you do, instead of appearing as mist, you appear as a swirling puff of feathers.
Your body is covered in feathers.
You have advantage on death saving throws.
You have disadvantage on all saving throws except death saving throws.
You can cast {@spell speak with animals} at will, but can use it to communicate only with dogs.
All cats are automatically hostile toward you.
You can cast the {@spell raise dead} spell once, requiring no material components.
If you drop to 0 hit points, you automatically suffer 1 failed death saving throw.
Each time you finish a short rest, up to 100 silver pieces already in your possession become gold pieces, and up to 100 copper pieces become silver pieces.
All coins you touch become worthless tin.
Anything poisonous within 50 feet of you is automatically detected and marked by the image of a small frog that is visible only to you.
A dozen small frogs constantly follow you around, chirping loudly.
You gain the benefit of a {@spell nondetection} spell.
Your appearance changes randomly as determined by the DM, as if you were under the effect of a {@spell disguise self} spell.
You can cast the {@spell mage hand} cantrip at will.
A disembodied spirit follows you around, stealing and scattering coins from you, crumbling your food, and playing with your weapons and gear.
You are able to decipher any text.
You lose the ability to speak any language. This has no effect on casting spells with verbal components.
You can cast the {@spell speak with plants} spell three times.
Your skin turns green, and you must drink a half gallon of fresh water every 4 hours or take {@damage 1d4} necrotic damage.
You know whether creatures within 15 feet of you are lying, as if you were the center of a {@spell zone of truth} spell.
Whenever you would speak falsely, you cannot speak at all.
You gain a sense of destiny that directs you toward an important goal, as determined by the DM.
Your head is filled with an unpleasant buzzing that imposes disadvantage on Intelligence checks and saving throws.

All creatures you speak with automatically believe your words, as if you have succeeded on a Charisma ({@skill Deception} or {@skill Persuasion}) check against them. Any sign of threatening or duplicitous action on your part negates this automatic success.
Your personal tastes reverse, such that your favorite foods, hobbies, music, and so forth become unbearable to you.
Your shadow becomes an undead {@creature shadow} that shares your alignment and is under your control.
Your shadow behaves disapprovingly whenever you're not looking—stealing things, mocking you behind your back, taunting opponents or friends, and so on.
Your skin is covered by slime. You automatically succeed on ability checks and saving throws made to escape a grapple.
Your skin is covered by slime. You must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw to sit down, open doors, and perform other mundane tasks of the DM's determination.
Flowers turn to face you as you pass them.
Mundane animals can't look at you.

Each time you finish a short rest, you suddenly sprout a covering of fragrant leaves. The leaves fall off after {@dice 1d10} minutes, revealing {@dice 1d6} magic fruits that can be plucked from your head. Each fruit functions as a berry created with the {@spell goodberry} spell.
Whenever you stop moving for 10 minutes or more, you discover that your boots or shoes have set down roots that must be pulled free with a successful {@dc 20} Strength check.
Choose a creature you can see. That creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or drop one item they are holding (DM's choice). You can use this property three times.
Each time you roll a 1 on a Dexterity check, you drop one object you are holding (DM's choice).

A group of small forest animals appears and follows you everywhere, singing and dancing. These magical creatures can perform any task you desire that could be performed by a {@spell prestidigitation} spell.
You break out into song whenever you roll a 1 on any die.

Your possessions change their state or appearance at the DM's determination, giving you hints of potential future events. For example, your sword might become suddenly bloodstained to warn of an upcoming combat encounter, your clothes might become damp to warn of a water-filled pit trap ahead, and so on.
You take a −5 penalty to initiative rolls.
Whenever you roll a 1 on a {@dice d20}, you have advantage on your next {@dice d20} roll.
Whenever you roll a 1 on a {@dice d20}, you have disadvantage on your next {@dice d20} roll.
Grass, moss, and flowers instantly grow in your footsteps. You are also unaffected by {@quickref difficult terrain||3} created by plants.
Any harm that befalls a plant you can see (a woodcutter sawing down a tree, a gardener pulling weeds, and so forth) fills you with a sadness that imposes disadvantage on ability checks for 1 minute.
You automatically know the direction to the greatest danger within 500 feet of you.
You leave a trail of black footprints that allow anyone to automatically follow you.
You can cast the {@spell detect thoughts} spell three times.
All creatures within 30 feet of you automatically know your surface thoughts, as if having cast {@spell detect thoughts} against you.
You can cast the {@spell misty step} spell three times. When you do, you must begin and end your teleportation in an area of shadow.
While in direct sunlight, you have disadvantage on attack rolls as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.
Creatures cannot gain advantage on attacks made against you as a result of another creature using the {@action Help} action.
You have disadvantage on Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) checks.
You have increased lung capacity, increasing your walking speed by 10 feet and letting you hold your breath for twice as long as normal.
Whenever you exert yourself by fighting, running, and so forth, you breathe out intermittent gouts of flame that deal {@damage 1d4} fire damage to you.
You can cast the {@spell daylight} spell three times.
An evil undead creature that comes within 30 feet of you for the first time is {@condition charmed} by you until the end of your next turn.
When you touch a copper piece, it transmutes to become two copper pieces. You can duplicate a maximum of 1,000 coins this way.
Food doesn't satiate you, and you must eat double the amount of food you normally eat to avoid feeling hungry.
You shed light like a torch, as if you were the target of a {@spell light} cantrip.
No one else can take a short rest within 40 feet of you, as everything you say or do seems distracting to them.
You can cast the {@spell divination} spell once.
Whenever you make an Intelligence check or saving throw, you receive a grim vision of the DM's determination, imposing disadvantage on your next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw.

As an action, you can become incorporeal for 10 minutes, allowing you to move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. You take 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if you end your turn inside an object. You can use this property once.
Your senses diminish as if the world were faded around you, imposing disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks.
While you take a short rest, the area within 50 feet of you takes on the illusory appearance of a beautiful forest glade.
The first time an ally you can see takes damage as a result of failing a saving throw, you take the damage instead of them.
As a bonus action, you can choose one creature within 10 feet of you and know one secret about it, as determined by the DM.
The {@spell remove curse}, {@spell lesser restoration}, and {@spell greater restoration} spells have no effect on you.
You can predict the weather conditions for the next 24 hours with perfect accuracy.
A rain cloud follows you around, drizzling on you constantly even while indoors.
You have telepathy out to a range of 120 feet.
You hear the voices of creatures you can see in your head from time to time (as detailed by the DM), but you have no idea whether what you're hearing is the truth or not.
You can cast {@spell speak with animals} at will, but you can use it to communicate only with goats. Any goat you speak with becomes {@condition charmed} by you for 1 hour.
You become distraught unless your clothing is all the same color, imposing disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma checks and saving throws.
你具有火焰傷害抗性。
You gain no benefit from any potion.
You have immunity to the {@condition charmed} and {@condition frightened} conditions.
You can speak only in a monotone voice, imposing disadvantage on Charisma checks.
You and each creature within 10 feet of you have resistance to necrotic damage.
Any Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check you make or that is made to help you is made with disadvantage.
The first creature you hit with a weapon attack on each of your turns takes {@damage 1d4} fire damage at the start of its next turn.
You are {@condition blinded} while in bright light, and your shadow takes on a monstrous appearance.
No creature can learn your alignment by magical means, and you have advantage on Charisma checks involving creatures that also share your alignment.
You have disadvantage on Charisma checks involving creatures that do not share your alignment.
As a bonus action, you cause yourself and a willing ally you can see to swap positions by teleportation.
Whenever you roll a 1 on a {@dice d20} roll, you and an ally you can see swap positions by teleportation.
As an action, you cause {@quickref difficult terrain||3} within 50 feet of you to become normal terrain. You can use this property three times.
Each time you move through {@quickref difficult terrain||3}, your speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of your next turn.
You increase one ability score of your choice by 2. You can increase an ability score above 20 using this property, but the increase is lost when this property ends.
Whenever you roll a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw using your highest ability score, you take {@damage 1d4} psychic damage.
As an action, you learn the direction and distance to the nearest magic item not in the possession of you or any of your allies.
Each creature within 30 feet of you automatically knows which magic items you carry.

As an action while you are in dim light or darkness, you can become {@condition invisible}, as if targeted by the {@spell invisibility} spell. In addition to becoming visible if you attack or cast a spell, you become visible if you move into bright light. You can use this property three times.
While in bright light, you have disadvantage on initiative rolls.
You can read and understand all the languages commonly spoken within 1 mile of you, as determined by the DM.
While speaking, you occasionally use nonsense words, imposing disadvantage on Charisma checks.
You know one cantrip of the DM's choice, and can cast one 1st-level spell of the DM's choice at will.

Whenever you cast a spell or use a magic item property that requires an action or a bonus action to activate, roll on the {@table Wild Magic Surge|PHB} table (see the sorcerer section in chapter 3 of the Player's Handbook) to see what happens.
Whenever you roll a 20 on a {@dice d20}, you can immediately end one effect on you.
Whenever you roll a 1 on a {@dice d20}, you are {@condition blinded} until the end of your next turn.

Any clothing you wear is covered with a magical map image that shows all the local area you are aware of. This map doesn't reveal anything you don't know, but grants advantage on ability checks to find secret doors and to navigate back to where you've been.
Any rope you touch transforms into a {@creature poisonous snake} that attacks you.
You summon a {@creature slithering tracker|VGM} that obeys your commands.
You take on the appearance of having translucent skin, with your bones and organs slightly visible within.
You have a fresh-scrubbed appearance, and a sweet perfume surrounds you. You have advantage on Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) checks.
Whenever you fail a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check, the subject of the check becomes irrationally resentful of you, seeking to undermine you in ways determined by the DM.
You can cast the {@spell control weather} spell.

Each time you deal or take cold damage or fire damage, you must succeed on a {@dc 10} Charisma saving throw or accidentally summon a hostile {@creature air elemental} or {@creature fire elemental} (depending on the damage dealt).
A tiny construct resembling a {@creature gynosphinx} follows you around. It can truthfully answer up to ten yes-or-no questions regarding the campaign, at the DM's discretion.
A tiny construct resembling a {@creature gynosphinx} follows you around. It constantly asks unsolvable riddles of other creatures, and insults those creatures when they fail to answer correctly.

A creature appears next to you that is a hybrid of any two nonmagical beasts (akin to the {@creature owlbear}). The creature serves you as if created by a {@spell conjure animals} spell. The DM determines the creature's statistics.

A creature appears next to you that is a hybrid of any two nonmagical beasts (akin to the {@creature owlbear}). Unless you succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling}) check, the creature attacks you before wandering off. The DM determines the creature's statistics.
You can cast the {@spell teleport} spell, always arriving on target when you do. You can use this property once.

Each time you walk through a doorway or similar portal, you must succeed on a {@dc 10} Intelligence check or step into a skewed timeline. On a failure, you and all allies within 10 feet of you skip ahead {@dice 1d4} minutes. To other creatures, it appears that you and other affected creatures disappear for that length of time, then appear again in the doorway.
You can cast the {@spell haste} spell on yourself. You can use this property three times.
Each time you are reduced to 0 hit points then stabilized, you suffer the effect of a {@spell slow} spell.
You do not need to breathe and cease to do so, making you immune to inhaled poisons and suffocation.
Whenever you speak (including casting a spell with a verbal component), you must first use a bonus action to breathe.

Your blood is venomous, granting you immunity to poison and to the {@condition poisoned} condition. You can cast the {@spell speak with animals} spell at will, but you can use it to communicate only with snakes.

Your tongue is long and forked, causing you to speak in a hiss. You have disadvantage on Charisma checks involving speech, and you must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution check to cast a spell with a verbal component.

You grow gills and have the ability to breathe air and water. You also sprout a pair of tentacles from your shoulders that have a reach of 10 feet and can be used to perform any action you could perform with your hands. The tentacles cannot attack or grapple.

You are constantly followed by {@dice 1d4} {@creature octopus||octopuses} that can breathe air and water, and which have a walking speed of 30 feet. Each time combat breaks out, you must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling}) check or have the octopuses panic and attack you.

You can cast the {@spell misty step} spell three times. When you do, you must begin and end your teleportation in an area of fire. Any fire damage you take during the same turn in which you use {@spell misty step} is restored automatically at the end of your turn.
Whenever you start your turn within 30 feet of an ongoing fire effect, you must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or move toward the fire and into it if possible.
When you look at the sky, you see it overlaid with navigational symbols. You have advantage on ability checks made to avoid becoming lost while outdoors.
You have disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks while indoors.
You can cast the {@spell healing word} spell three times.
Undead are drawn to you, making it impossible for you to hide from them. Each undead creature you face in combat has advantage on its first attack roll against you.
Any food you touch is transformed into a culinary delight. You have advantage on Charisma checks while interacting with any creatures that have eaten of this food.
You constantly hear distracting music that throws off your timing, imposing disadvantage on initiative rolls and Dexterity checks.
Your mind is filled with lost facts and lore, granting advantage on Intelligence checks.
You forget your name, and must be constantly reminded of it by your allies.
Your touch can change small nonmagical objects into chocolate.
Anything you eat or drink makes you feel overly sated and full, imposing disadvantage on Strength checks for 1 hour.
Each time you finish a short rest, you regain {@dice 1d8} hit points. Each creature that took a short rest with you and remained within 30 feet of you for the duration also gains this benefit.

Each time you finish a short rest, you take {@damage 3d8} psychic damage. At your determination, you can transfer some or all of this damage to any creatures that took a short rest with you and remained within 30 feet of you for the duration.
Each time you finish a short rest, you find {@dice 1d10} small gems worth 10 gp each in your possession.
Whenever you spend coins or gems, any character you give them to becomes convinced that the wealth was stolen from them.
When you hit a creature for the first time during an encounter, its Armor Class is reduced by 1.
Whenever you roll a 1 on a weapon attack roll, the weapon shatters like glass. The weapon magically reforms in {@dice 1d4} rounds.
Each time you enter a settlement, you are treated as though you are known there and a friend, even if you are neither.
Each time you roll a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you grow one inch taller. Your clothing and armor does not grow with you.
While standing in a doorway, you can cast the {@spell teleport} spell. Your destination must be another doorway you know. You can use this property once.
Each time you finish a short rest, you forget one of your allies (of the DM's choice) and no longer trust that character. You lose this distrust at the end of your next short rest.

As an action, you cause a swirling storm of rocks and dust to surround you in a 10-foot radius for 1 minute. Each creature hostile to you that enters the area must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 1d6} bludgeoning damage and be {@condition blinded} for 1 round. You can use this property three times.

{@creature fire elemental||Fire elementals}, {@creature water elemental||water elementals}, and other creatures of fire and water (as determined by the DM) regard you as their enemy, and focus their attacks against you to the exclusion of all else.
As an action, you learn the names of every humanoid creature within 30 feet of you.
Whenever you roll a 1 on a Strength or Dexterity check that incorporates touching an object, you stick to that object for 1 minute. It takes a successful {@dc 20} Strength check to free yourself.
You can cast the {@spell modify memory} spell once.
Whenever you make an Intelligence check or saving throw, you must succeed on a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw or lose all your memories of the past hour.
You can ignore the verbal component of any spell you cast.
You must shout the verbal component of any spell you cast.
As an action, you conjure a mindless, shapeless force that is your exact duplicate. You control this force as if it were the product of an {@spell unseen servant} spell, except that it is visible.

Each time you see your own reflection, you must succeed on a {@dc 12} Charisma saving throw. On a failure, you treat your allies as enemies and vice versa for 1 minute, attacking the wrong targets, betraying your companions in social situations, and so forth. You can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of your turns, ending the effect on a success.
As an action, you can replace one of your hands with any nonmagical weapon, tool, or piece of adventuring equipment of reasonable size (as determined by the DM).

Your hands feel unnaturally large, imposing disadvantage on Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) checks and Dexterity checks using {@item thieves' tools|PHB} or {@item artisan's tools|PHB}. The first weapon attack roll you make in any encounter is made with disadvantage.
All creatures of a particular type other than humanoid (as chosen by the DM) are incapable of acting hostile toward you as long as you do not attack, threaten, or provoke them.

Whenever you meet a creature of a particular type other than humanoid (as chosen by the DM), there is a 1 percent cumulative chance that the {@creature tarrasque} is magically summoned within 1 mile of you. The tarrasque has no knowledge of your existence. It runs amok for {@dice 1d6 × 10} minutes, then magically returns to its previous location.

item.name: Theki Root
entries: 這種粗大的沼澤根嚐起來很苦，但被認為有助於消化健康。當你使用一個動作服用一劑時，你在 8 小時內對抗有毒或毒性物質效果的豁免檢定具有優勢。

item.name: Thermal Cube
entries: 這個 3 吋見方的實心硫磺方塊會產生足夠的乾熱，讓它 15 呎內的溫度保持在華氏 95 度（攝氏 35 度）。

item.name: Thessaltoxin
entries: This poison was first created using blood harvested from the artificer Thessalar. A creature subjected to the poison must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take on a new form as if affected by the {@spell polymorph} spell. The creature's new form is a random beast or a creature it has seen within the last 24 hours (as chosen by the DM). This transformation lasts until the end of the target's next long rest. This effect is not subject to {@spell dispel magic} or {@spell remove curse}, but a {@spell greater restoration} spell restores the creature to its original form.

item.name: Thessaltoxin Antidote
entries: This potion appears to change color and texture each time you look at it. When you drink the potion, it ends the {@spell polymorph} effect imposed by thessaltoxin.

item.name: Thieves' Tools
entries: 這一組工具包括了一把小銼刀、一套開鎖工具、一面附有鐵柄的小鏡、一組窄刃剪刀、以及一對鉗子。熟練於這套工具組能讓你將你的熟練加值加到任何你在為了解除陷阱或開鎖時所進行的屬性檢定中。
additionalEntries: 也許是最常被冒險者們使用的工具，盜賊工具被設計用於開鎖和解除陷阱。熟練於此工具也會賦予你關於陷阱和鎖的基本知識。

additionalEntries.name: Components
entries: 盜賊工具包括了把小銼刀、一套開鎖工具、一面附有鐵柄的小鏡、一組窄刃剪刀、以及一對鉗子。

additionalEntries.name: History
entries: 你對陷阱的知識讓你在回答關於以它們陷阱所著名的地區的問題時提出深刻的見解。

additionalEntries.name: Investigation and Perception
entries: 你在尋找陷阱時獲得更進一步的洞察力，因為你熟知那些會暴露它們存在的常見跡象。

additionalEntries.name: Set a Trap
entries: 就如同你能解除陷阱，你也同樣能設置它們。做為短休的一部份，你可以使用你手邊的物品製作一個陷阱。你檢定的總和將成為其他人發現和解除這個陷阱的DC。這個陷阱所造成的傷害會根據其製造時所用的材料（像是毒藥或武器）、或者造成等同你檢定總和一半的傷害，由DM決定何者較合適。

item.name: Throne Card
entries: 作為一個動作，你可以在持握這張牌時說出命令語，使你在 1 分鐘內於魅力（{@skill Intimidation||威嚇}或{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定上具有優勢。此外，在此期間，你可以使用一個動作以這張牌施展{@spell Command||命令術}法術（豁免 {@dc 17}）。此屬性使用後，在下一個黎明之前無法再次使用。

item.name: Thunder Absorbing Tattoo
entries: {#itemEntry Absorbing Tattoo|TCE}

item.name: Thunderbuss
entries: 這把魔法遠程武器是一把喇叭口手槍，槍管上刻著風暴符文。你以它進行的攻擊檢定與傷害擲骰獲得 +1 加值。它不需要彈藥，造成雷鳴傷害而非穿刺傷害，且不具有裝填屬性。

entries.name: Invoking the Rune
entries: 作為一個附贈動作，你可以引動武器的符文，將一顆能量球發射到你 30 呎內一個你能看見的點。能量接著引爆，形成以該點為中心、半徑 10 呎的狂風雷鳴球形，該球形內的每個生物都必須進行一次 {@dc 14} 體質豁免檢定。豁免失敗時，生物受到 {@damage 3d6} 點雷鳴傷害，且在你下個回合結束前無法採取反應。豁免成功時，生物只受到一半傷害。
符文被引動後，在下一個黎明之前無法再次引動。

item.name: Thunderous Greatclub
entries: 與此魔法武器同調時，你的力量為 20，除非你的力量已等於或高於該數值。此武器對其命中的任何生物額外造成 {@damage 1d8} 雷鳴傷害，並對其命中、未被穿戴或攜帶的物體額外造成 {@damage 3d8} 雷鳴傷害。
此武器具有以下額外屬性。

entries.name: Clap of Thunder
entries: 作為一個{@action Magic|XPHB|魔法}動作，你可以用武器敲擊堅硬的表面，製造一聲 300 呎外都能聽見的響亮雷鳴。你也會創造一道 30 呎{@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|錐形}的雷鳴能量。{@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|錐形}範圍內的每個生物必須通過一次 {@dc 15} 力量豁免檢定，否則處於{@condition Prone|XPHB|伏地}狀態。{@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|錐形}範圍內未被穿戴或攜帶的非魔法物體受到 {@damage 3d8} 雷鳴傷害。

entries.name: Earthquake
entries: 作為一個{@action Magic|XPHB|魔法}動作，你可以用武器敲擊地面，在以撞擊點為中心、半徑 50 呎的圓形範圍內製造劇烈的地震。該區域內與地面接觸的建築物受到 50 點鈍擊傷害，而該區域內地面上的每個生物必須通過一次 {@dc 20} 敏捷豁免檢定，否則處於{@condition Prone|XPHB|伏地}狀態。若該生物也正在{@status Concentration|XPHB|專注}，它必須通過一次 {@dc 20} 體質豁免檢定，否則其{@status Concentration|XPHB|專注}中斷。此外，你可以使區域內任何地方的地面裂開一道深 30 呎、寬 10 呎的裂縫。位於裂縫開啟處的任何生物必須進行一次 {@dc 20} 敏捷豁免檢定，失敗時墜入裂縫，成功時隨裂縫邊緣移動。位於裂縫開啟處的任何建築物會崩塌掉入裂縫中。使用此屬性後，直到下一個黎明前都無法再次使用。

item.name: Tidecaller Trident
entries: 你以這把魔法三叉戟進行的攻擊檢定與傷害擲骰獲得 +2 加值。你在水下以這把武器進行的攻擊檢定也具有優勢。
這把三叉戟有 3 點充能。你可以消耗 1 點充能從三叉戟施展{@spell Control Water||操控水體}（豁免 {@dc 15}），或改為消耗 3 點充能從它施展{@spell Tsunami||海嘯術}（豁免 {@dc 15}）。三叉戟每天黎明恢復 {@dice 1d3} 點已消耗的充能。

item.name: Tiger Eye
entries: 棕中帶金的透光寶石。

item.name: Tiger Eye
entries: 一顆中心帶有金色的棕色寶石。

item.name: Timepiece of Travel
entries: 與這個裝置同調時，你的敏捷豁免檢定獲得 +1 加值，且你總是知道哪個方向是北方。此外，你可以隨意對自己施展{@spell longstrider||大步奔行}法術。

entries.name: Turn-by-Turn Directions
entries: 你可以說出你目前位置 10 哩內任何一個地點，只要該地點 10 哩內至少有一個生物（包括你）知道它。你說出地點後，一個只有你聽得見的無形聲音會以最安全、最直接的路線提供前往該地點的方向。這個聲音知道要避開自然危害，因此不會讓你穿越無路可循的荒野或走進湖中。但它不知道也無法幫你避開怪物、敵人、陷阱、上鎖的門等。
時計對於前往完全保密或範圍內沒有任何生物知道的地點毫無用處。你使用旅行時計的這項特性後，在下一個黎明之前無法再次使用。

entries.name: Get Away From It All
entries: 作為一個動作，你可以施展{@spell teleport||傳送術}法術。你使用旅行時計的這項特性後，在下一個黎明之前無法再次使用。

entries.name: Part of a Whole
entries: 當這個零件未安裝在{@item Orrery of the Wanderer|AI|漫遊者天象儀}中時，它的魔法可能會時有時無地運作，或產生無法預測的副作用，由 DM 決定。

item.name: Tinderbox
entries: 這個小容器內含了燧石、打火鐵、和火種（通常為浸泡過燈油的乾布料）用以生火。用其來點亮火炬 ─ 或其它有著充沛、外露燃料的東西 ─ 需要一個動作。點亮其它火苗則需要1分鐘。

item.name: Tinderbox
entries: 打火匣是一個小容器，裝有用於生火的燧石、火鋼與火絨（通常是浸過輕油的乾布）。用它點燃{@item Candle|XPHB|蠟燭}、{@item Lamp|XPHB|油燈}、{@item Hooded Lantern|XPHB|提燈}或{@item Torch|XPHB|火炬}（或任何有外露燃料的物品）需要一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}。點燃其他任何火需要 1 分鐘。

item.name: Tinderstrike
entries: 作為一把燧石匕首，焰襲有著極為奇特的形狀，它的刀刃異常鋒利，且當它擊中堅硬的物體時，它的邊緣就會迸發出火花。它的刀柄摸上去總是很溫暖，刀刃在使用後會悶燒{@dice 1d4}分鐘。它內部蘊含著邪惡的火元素親王{@creature Imix|PotA|伊密克斯}的碎片。
你在使用這把武器進行的攻擊檢定和傷害骰上具有+2加值。當你用它造成傷害時，目標將會額外受到{@dice 2d6}火焰傷害。

entries.name: Fire Mastery
entries: 當你持握焰襲時，你獲得以下好處：

items: 你可以流利地使用火族語。
你對火焰傷害具有抗性。
你可以對{@creature Fire Elemental||火元素}施放{@spell Dominate Monster||支配怪物}(DC 17)。一旦你這麼做，焰襲的這個能力直到下次日出前都無法再被使用。

entries.name: Dance of the All-Consuming Fire
entries: 當位於一個火元素節點內時，你可以施展一個名為「焚世烈焰之舞」的儀式，使用焰襲製造一個{@item Devastation Orb of Fire|PotA|毀滅法球(火)}。一旦你執行了這個儀式，焰襲直到下次日出前都不能再被用於施展這個儀式。

entries.name: Flaw
entries: 焰襲會讓持用者變得急躁和魯莽。當你與該武器同調時，你獲得以下缺陷：「我做事不加思考，冒險不考慮後果。」

item.name: Tome of Clear Thought
entries: 這本書記載著關於記憶力和邏輯的鍛鍊訣竅，且它的文字充滿著魔力。若你在6天或更短的期間內花費了總共48小時的時間研讀這本書的內容，並實踐它的指示，則你的智力值和智力值上限都將增加2點。這本手冊接著將失去它的魔力，並在一個世紀之後恢復。

item.name: Tome of Clear Thought
entries: 這本書載有記憶與邏輯的練習，其文字蘊含魔力。若你在 6 天或更短的期間內花費 48 小時研讀此書的內容並實踐其指引，你的智力提升 2，最高至 30。之後手冊會失去魔力，但會在一個世紀後恢復。

item.name: Tome of Leadership and Influence
entries: 這本書記載著關於影響力和吸引他人的訣竅，且它的文字充滿著魔力。若你在6天或更短的期間內花費了總共48小時的時間研讀這本書的內容，並實踐它的指示，則你的魅力值和魅力值上限都將增加2點。這本手冊接著將失去它的魔力，並在一個世紀之後恢復。

item.name: Tome of Leadership and Influence
entries: 這本書載有影響與魅惑他人的指引，其文字蘊含魔力。若你在 6 天或更短的期間內花費 48 小時研讀此書的內容並實踐其指引，你的魅力提升 2，最高至 30。之後手冊會失去魔力，但會在一個世紀後恢復。

item.name: Tome of Strahd
entries: The Tome of Strahd is an ancient work penned by Strahd, a tragic tale of how he came to his fallen state. The book is bound in a thick leather cover with steel hinges and fastenings. The pages are of parchment and very brittle. Most of the book is written in the curious shorthand that only Strahd employs. Stains and age have made most of the work illegible, but several paragraphs remain intact.

item.name: Tome of the Dragon
entries: This heavy tome is bound in dragonhide and reinforced with thick bands of cold iron. The original copies were made by wyrmspeakers of the {@book Cult of the Dragon|FRHoF|6|Cult of the Dragon} and bear that cult's symbol on their cover. The Tome of the Dragon contains the secret ritual to transform a dragon or a dead dragon's body into a dracolich.

To decipher and use the Tome of the Dragon, you must be either a spellcaster with at least two level 5 spell slots or a Dragon. A single assistant (or more, at the DM's discretion) can help you conduct the ritual, so long as that assistant also meets the requirements to use the tome.

To create a dracolich using a Tome of the Dragon, you must have continuous access to the body of an adult or ancient dragon (either living or dead), as well as 80,000 GP worth of supplies (which includes a gem that will serve as the anchor for the dracolich's spirit). While you have the necessary materials, you must conduct a ritual that lasts 180 days divided by the number of creatures conducting the ritual. During the ritual, you and any assistants must work without interruption, resting no more than 8 hours per day. If you are a Dragon, the cost of supplies and the ritual's duration are halved.

When the ritual is complete, the tome explodes with violet light, dealing ({@dice 12d6}) Necrotic damage to you and each assistant. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, the creature is killed and immediately reanimates as a {@creature Zombie|XMM} under the DM's control.

At the end of the ritual, the target transforms into a {@creature Dracolich|XMM}. If the ritual's target was a living dragon, that dragon dies instantly, and its spirit is transferred to the gem supplied for the ritual. If the target was a dead dragon's body, the body reanimates, and the gem is inhabited by an evil dragon spirit from the Outer Planes. The dracolich is under no obligation toward its creators and acts according to its nature.

item.name: Tome of the Stilled Tongue
entries: 這本以厚重皮革包覆的卷冊在封面上釘著一條風乾的舌頭。這種卷冊共有五冊存在，且沒有人知道哪一本才是原版。第一本靜語卷冊那裝飾著可怕封面的舌頭，曾經屬於一名背叛了巫妖之神，守密者維克那的僕人。而釘在另外四本複製品封面上的舌頭則來自於其他冒犯了維克那的施法者。每本卷冊的前幾頁都寫滿了無法解讀的潦草字跡，而剩餘的書頁則潔白如新。
若你可以與這個物品同調，則你可以使用它做為一本法術書和一件奧術法器。此外，當持握這本卷冊時，你可以使用一個附贈動作以施放一個你已經寫在這本卷冊上的法術，且無須消耗法術位或使用任何聲音或姿勢構材。一旦被使用，這本卷冊的此特性直到下次日出前都不能再被使用。
當與這本卷冊同調時，你可以將其舌頭從這本書的封面移除。若你這麼做，則所有被寫在書中的法術都將被永久抹消。
維克那留意著任何使用這本卷冊的人。祂也可以在這本書上寫下加密過的訊息。這些訊息將在午夜出現，並在它們被閱讀之後消失不見。

item.name: Tome of the Stilled Tongue
entries: 這本書的封面上釘著一條乾癟的舌頭。這種書共有五本，沒有人知道哪一本是原版。第一本噤聲之書上的舌頭，屬於巫妖{@book 維克那|XDMG|8|Vecna}一名奸詐的前僕從。釘在四本抄本封面上的舌頭，則來自其他得罪了維克那的施法者。每本書的前幾頁都寫滿了無法解讀的潦草字跡，其餘書頁則是空白的。
與此物品同調時，你可以將它作為法術書與奧術法器使用。此外，持有此書時，你可以執行一個{@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|附贈動作}施展一道你寫在此書中的法術，無需消耗法術欄位，也無需使用任何言語或姿勢成分。此屬性使用後，直到下一個黎明前都無法再次使用。
只有你能將舌頭從書的封面上取下。若你這麼做，書中寫的所有法術都會被永久抹除。
維克那會注視任何使用此書的人，並能在書中寫下隱晦的訊息。這些訊息通常在被讀過後便會消失。

item.name: Tome of Understanding
entries: 這本書記載著關於直覺和洞察力的鍛鍊訣竅，且它的文字充滿著魔力。若你在6天或更短的期間內花費了總共48小時的時間研讀這本書的內容，並實踐它的指示，則你的感知值和感知值上限都將增加2點。這本手冊接著將失去它的魔力，並在一個世紀之後恢復。

item.name: Tome of Understanding
entries: 這本書載有直覺與洞察的練習，其文字蘊含魔力。若你在 6 天或更短的期間內花費 48 小時研讀此書的內容並實踐其指引，你的感知提升 2，最高至 30。之後手冊會失去魔力，但會在一個世紀後恢復。

item.name: Topaz
entries: 金黃色的透光寶石。

item.name: Topaz
entries: 一顆金黃色的寶石。

item.name: Topaz Annihilator
entries: This magic ranged weapon resembles a {@item musket|DMG}, but in lieu of any ammunition, it holds a glowing yellow scale from a topaz dragon in its heart.

The weapon has a normal range of 100 feet and a long range of 300 feet, and it has the two-handed property. It deals {@damage 2d6} necrotic damage on a hit. If this damage reduces a creature or object to 0 hit points, the target is reduced to dust. A creature reduced to dust can be restored to life only by a {@spell true resurrection} or {@spell wish} spell.
While the weapon is on your person, you can use an action to cast the {@spell disintegrate} spell (save {@dc 18}). Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Torch
entries: 一支火炬可以燃燒1小時，提供20呎半徑的明亮光照和再延伸20呎的微光光照。如果你使用燃燒中的火炬進行一次近戰攻擊，它會造成1火焰傷害。

item.name: Torch
entries: 火炬可燃燒 1 小時，在 20 呎半徑內發出{@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB|明亮光照}，並在其外額外 20 呎發出{@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB|微弱光照}。當你執行{@action Attack|XPHB|攻擊}動作時，你可以用火炬攻擊，將其當作簡易近戰武器使用。命中時，目標受到 1 點火焰傷害。

item.name: Torpor
entries: 受此毒藥影響的生物必須成功通過一次 {@dc 15} 體質豁免檢定，否則{@condition poisoned||中毒} {@dice 4d6} 小時。{@condition poisoned||中毒}的生物處於{@condition incapacitated||無力}狀態。

item.name: Torpor
entries: 受到昏睡毒影響的生物必須通過一次 {@dc 15} 體質豁免檢定，否則處於{@condition Poisoned|XPHB|中毒}狀態 {@dice 4d6} 小時。以此方式{@condition Poisoned|XPHB|中毒}期間，該生物的{@variantrule Speed|XPHB|速度}減半。

item.name: Tourmaline
entries: 淡綠色、藍色、褐色、或紅色的透光寶石。

item.name: Tourmaline
entries: 一顆淡綠色、藍色、棕色或紅色的寶石。

item.name: Travel Alchemical Kit
entries: 同樣在等級 3 時，總部會提供你一套旅行煉金工具組——一件非普通魔法物品，內含{@item alchemist's supplies|phb|煉金師設備}與{@item poisoner's kit|phb|製毒工具組}的迷你版本（玻璃小瓶、研缽與研杵、化學藥劑與玻璃攪拌棒）。作為這次升級的一部分，你獲得{@item poisoner's kit|phb|製毒工具組}的熟練。
只要這套魔法工具組在你身上，你就可以使用它，不需要取出或收起。若你被搜身，找到你的旅行煉金工具組需要成功通過一次 {@dc 20} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）或感知（{@skill Insight||察言觀色}）檢定。

item.name: Traveler's Clothes
entries: 旅行者服裝是耐用的衣物，專為在各種環境中旅行而設計。

item.name: Treasure chest crafted of exotic wood with gold fittings and opals (Brazen Coalition)
item.name_zh: 以珍奇木材製成、飾有金配件與蛋白石的寶箱（銅鑄聯盟）
item._zhOf: Treasure chest crafted of exotic wood with gold fittings and opals (Brazen Coalition)

item.name: Trident of Fish Command
entries: 這個三叉戟是一把魔法武器。它含有3發充能。當你攜帶它時，你可以使用一個動作以消耗1發充能，並從它對一個具有天生游泳速度的野獸施放{@spell Dominate Beast||支配野獸}法術（豁免DC 15）。這把三叉戟會在每天日出時恢復{@dice 1d3}發已消耗的充能。

item.name: Trident of Fish Command
entries: 此魔法武器有 3 發充能，每天黎明恢復 {@dice 1d3} 發已消耗的充能。攜帶它時，你可以消耗 1 發充能，從中對一隻具有{@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB|游泳速度}的野獸施展{@spell Dominate Beast|XPHB|支配野獸}（豁免 {@dc 15}）。

item.name: Trinket
entries: 擔心自己在公司活動上拿出裝在透明玻璃瓶裡的死掉的精靈，卻發現加盟店裡另外三個人也有一個？那就考慮在收購股份有限公司小玩意表上擲骰，而不是{@item Trinket|phb|《玩家手冊》第 5 章的表}，在創建角色時獲得一件帶有收購公司風格的獨特小玩意。

entries.caption: 收購股份有限公司小玩意
rows: 一顆完美的打水漂石頭
三顆總是擲出小點數的灌鉛骰子
一個裝著吉姆·黑魔法照片的小盒墜
一個小鐵砧與鐵匠鎚
一根無法運作的定身桿
一套 DIY 針灸組
一個梟熊填充玩偶
一張新式戰爭魯特琴的設計圖
一份向一個沒人聽過的國家宣戰的宣言
一支會冒出綠煙的菸斗
一顆玻璃眼珠
一盞無價吊燈的中心裝飾
一根有暗格的精緻手杖

一個蛋殼，上面以令人不安的細節畫著悲慘的場景

item.name: True-Ice Shards (Dagger)
entries: {@note 此物品與{@item True-Ice Shards (Rapier)|CoA|真冰碎片（刺劍）}成對}
真冰碎片以囚禁萊維斯圖斯的那座冰河本身打造而成，是他所使用的一對刺劍與格擋匕首（左手短劍）。它們體現了他在冰河中度過的時光，增強心靈感應、預言與防禦。由於萊維斯圖斯能控制冰，他可以從任何地方召喚真冰碎片，即使它們已被摧毀也一樣。
使用這把魔法匕首時，只要將它作為副手武器使用，你的 AC 就獲得 +3 加值，且它造成 {@damage 1d6} 點寒冷傷害而非一般傷害。
由於萊維斯圖斯可以隨意召喚真冰碎片，他經常將這件神器的複製品賞賜給他最忠誠的追隨者。這些複製品與原版完全相同，只有一個例外：萊維斯圖斯可以隨時摧毀或收回複製品。

entries.name: Random Properties
entries: 真冰碎片具有以下隨機屬性：

items: 2 項{@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|dmg|主要有益}屬性
2 項{@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|dmg|次要有害}屬性
1 項{@table Artifact Properties; Major Detrimental Properties|dmg|主要有害}屬性

entries.name: Sub-Zero
entries: 以碎片造成的寒冷傷害無視抗性與免疫。易受寒冷傷害的生物從真冰碎片受到三倍傷害，而非兩倍。
當你以碎片對一個生物造成傷害後，你可以使用一個附贈動作迫使該生物進行一次 {@dc 22} 體質豁免檢定。豁免失敗時，受到傷害的生物在 24 小時內易受寒冷傷害。你使用此特性後，在完成一次長休之前無法再次使用。

entries.name: Mental Command
entries: 與真冰碎片同調時，你可以使用一個動作施展{@spell Detect Thoughts||偵測思想}法術（豁免 {@dc 20}），以任何你曾經見過的生物為目標。若目標生物位於不同的存在位面，法術會失敗。
只要你維持{@status concentration||專注}，你就可以使用一個附贈動作向專注的生物傳送心靈感應訊息。只要專注與{@status concentration||專注}持續，它就可以回覆——回覆需使用一個附贈動作。

entries.name: Omniscient
entries: 你可以使用真冰碎片施展各種預言法術。{@spell Locate Animals or Plants||動植物定位術}、{@spell Locate Creature||生物定位術}與{@spell Locate Object||物品定位術}可以隨意施展，且沒有最大範圍。這些法術的其他限制仍然適用，且它們無法偵測其他存在位面上的對象。
此外，你可以施展{@spell Scrying||探知}（法術豁免 DC 為 20）與{@spell Find the Path||尋找捷徑}。施展其中任一道法術後，你必須完成一次長休才能再次施展其中任一道。

entries.name: Destroying the Shards
entries: 只要萊維斯圖斯還活著，摧毀真冰碎片就沒什麼意義，因為他可以隨意重新創造它們。除此之外，碎片在受到足夠的熱源時可以被摧毀。這類熱源包括活火山內部、持續的獄火來源，或以 9 環施展的強大火焰法術。

item.name: True-Ice Shards (Rapier)

你以這把魔法刺劍進行的攻擊檢定與傷害擲骰獲得 +3 加值，且它造成 {@damage 1d8} 點寒冷傷害而非一般傷害。
由於萊維斯圖斯可以隨意召喚真冰碎片，他經常將這件神器的複製品賞賜給他最忠誠的追隨者。這些複製品與原版完全相同，只有一個例外：萊維斯圖斯可以隨時摧毀或收回複製品。
